limitations: Central Athens sample only; routes do not leave the rendered data rectangle.
Preview simulation, not turn-by-turn navigation or a guarantee of present-day legal access. No live closures, traffic or signals.
OSM topology snapshot requested at 2026-07-24T11:04:51Z to align with the original city roads. Source database timestamp is recorded separately.
Only common passenger-car road classes with unrestricted access are included. Pedestrian streets, footways, steps, paths, cycleways and private/destination-only access are excluded.
Bridges, tunnels, non-ground layers and unsupported conditional/via-way/same-way turn-restriction approaches are conservatively excluded.
Junctions join identical original OSM node IDs only; geometric crossings and nearby coordinates never create synthetic connections.

Destinations are the nearest original road nodes within 200 metres of landmark geometry with routes in both directions to every other offered destination after turn restrictions are enforced. They are not verified entrances or parking spaces.
Tagged maxspeed is retained where numeric; other speedKph values are explicitly simulation defaults. Widths and missing lane counts may be inferred.
Road lines follow OSM centre lines; lane markings and driver placement in the rendering are illustrative unless otherwise tagged.
